title: מנימין כנדוקא
author: Heilprin source tradition; Warsaw digital witness
attribution: Fresh project English, authored from the frozen Hebrew and revised through source-informed author and independent model review. Editorial-layer attribution in the Warsaw witness remains qualified.

paragraphs: Minyamin Kanduka: his kanduka of honey was uncovered. Rashi explains: a seller of jugs. Musaf HeArukh suggests perhaps one should read Panduka, like pundaki, an innkeeper, or Kevardaka, meaning a cook. He came before Rava, Elu Terefot 49b.
